project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions + Auth HO + Zod + Audit Logs

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, services, service_categories. Strategy: ABC Framework.

typography.exceptions: QuoteModernView branding (Watermark) uses hardcoded custom spacing/font weight.

components.ServiceMobileList: Compact row list with active expand state
components.QuoteModal: Compact, floating centered card (max-w 340px) vs V1 parity
components.VisualBuilder: Grid 7/5 Desktop, Single column Mobile, Canvas with GripVertical icons.

patterns.name: Quote Modal Parity Pattern
patterns.details: Always cap modal width to ~340-400px to maintain floating card feel. Avoid full-width on large screens.

patterns.name: Icon SSOT Strategy
patterns.details: Migrate 100% to Lucide-React. Use size={relative_size} instead of text-[px] for better cross-browser SVG scaling.

gotchas: calculateServiceStats MUST be sync/pure utility exported separately to avoid Next.js build errors in Server Action files.
Tailwind arbitrary values (like max-w-[340px]) in template literals often fail to generate classes via JIT; use static classes or inline style object props for layout-critical constraints.
Inline text-xs/text-sm in Visual Builder (Redesign-holdouts) leads to design drift. Always use typography.css classes.
